_comment: EXPANDED presenter gesture set — 18 Mixamo clips STAGED at /opt/mocap (was 9). intent -> Mixamo animation FBX. Fetched 2026-07-09 via Mixamo (Adobe login) as FBX Binary / Without Skin / In Place / 30fps. Mixamo animations target mixamorig:* == our canonical rig, so mixamo_bake.py is a near-identity name-match retarget (COPY_ROTATION LOCAL, rotation-only -> inherently in-place). `core:true` = the 12-clip priority set the auto-director uses. `synthesized:true` = hand-keyed (no download). `available:false` = considered but no clean Mixamo match (NOT downloaded) -> MUST stay OUT of canonical-clipmap.json or the bake RuntimeErrors on the missing FBX (mixamo_bake.py line 61). NEXT: verify PowerPoint's multi-clip ceiling (>9), then freeze canonical-clipmap.json v2 to the supported count, bake_clip_library --mixamo per profile, wire presenter-director. License: embed-in-product OK, no raw-file redistribution (.gitignore blocks *.fbx here).

idle.note: Mixamo 'Breathing Idle' — loopable resting stance (default between gestures)

talk.note: Mixamo 'Talking' — loopable speaking gesture (default while narrating)

emphasize.note: Mixamo 'Standing Arguing' — forceful two-hand emphatic chops

magnitude.note: Mixamo 'Rallying' — arms-raised expansive 'this is big' gesture

contrast.note: Mixamo 'Weight Shift Gesture' — alternating shift ('on one hand / on the other')

enumerate.note: hand-keyed alternating-hand beats (no download, zero provenance)

present.note: Mixamo 'Standing Greeting' — welcoming open gesture toward the audience

walk.note: Mixamo 'Walking' (In Place ON) — for Morph-travel between slides

point_up.note: SKIPPED — no clean upward-point in Mixamo (only forward/down variants, which duplicate 'point'). Director should fall back to 'point'.

wait.note: SKIPPED — no clean 'Hands On Hips' / 'Waiting' standing pose in Mixamo (fuzzy sits/poses only); redundant with 'idle'.

explain.note: SKIPPED — no 'Explaining' animation in Mixamo; redundant with 'talk' / 'emphasize'.
